# Contributor agreement: signed for all contributions

Each person below agreed to the [contributor agreement](../CONTRIBUTING.md#contributor-agreement) for **all of their past and future contributions** to Scribble2Fix. Each line is added in a commit by the person themselves, from their own GitHub account, so the git history shows who signed and when.

To sign, add a line in this form in a pull request (or a commit, if you have write access):

`- @your-github-name, YYYY-MM-DD: I agree to the contributor agreement in CONTRIBUTING.md for all my past and future contributions to Scribble2Fix.`

## Signed
